dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: Ugh, what am I gonna do? I can't even afford to hire anyone anymore... and our volcano project budget is just about drained. I need to come up with something...

dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, hey! This stuff's for selling. If you're not buying, you're not touchi— Huh... Hey, you! Yeah, you with the blonde hair — hold on a sec, don't rush off. Let me get a better look at you.

dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: Hmm, just as I thought. That hair, glowing like the sun, and those eyes, as deep as the Night Kingdom... I can tell — no, I'm sure — that you're going to become someone incredible one day.

dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: Here, I've got a set of wondrous jade ornaments, each containing a different melody. Perfect for a real hero like you!

dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: Mind you, these are nothing short of priceless treasures. If anyone else wanted to buy them, I'd be asking for at least 10 million Mora. But I see you're meant to have them, so you can have them at just one-tenth of the price. What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, one-tenth!? That's a steal! But wait, isn't that still at least... a million Mora? That's a bit much, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: Yeah, well... this is basically cost price. Small-time sellers like me don't make a ton of profit, you know?

choices.text: You really shouldn't be making money like that...

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: Ah, so you heard all that, huh? Haha, guess I've got a habit of talking to myself...

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: *sigh* Fine, since you caught me, I'll be real with you. I found this jade ornament by accident. It's not worth anywhere near that price.

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: But well, as you heard, we're kinda strapped for cash — so much so that we can't even pay anyone to collect the buoy data.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, then just forget the buoy collection! Better than ripping people off, right?

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: That won't do... Other organizations can just stop operating if they lack the funds, but our volunteer work also includes volcano observation.

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: We planted those buoys to measure volcanic activity by collecting data on water temperature and the like.

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: With the volcano becoming more active, we need to recover those buoys fast, or there could be serious consequences.

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: Injured as I am, I can't break the buoys, let alone retrieve the data from them...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}? Why don't we help her out? This volcano stuff affects everyone, so we can't just ignore it...

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: R—Really? If you're willing to help, these jade ornaments are all yours, for free! Consider it your reward. Sounds good?

choices.text: Didn't you mention a million Mora...?

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: Don't worry. We haven't got much, but we certainly have more to give you than just these jade ornaments.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, they're enough for us! After all, we're doing this for the safety of everyone near the volcano! So don't worry, we've got this.

choices.text: I'll need a moment to prepare.

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: I'm good to go anytime.

choices.text: Oh, so this is all I get for a reward, huh?
Weren't you the one who said that a helper's worth a million Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: Phew, what a relief. Looks like the volcano situation isn't as bad as we thought. Guess we can sleep easy tonight...

dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: It's all thanks to you, of course. If you hadn't stepped in and helped us without holding grudges, things wouldn't have gone so smoothly.

dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: Please, take this as a token of my gratitude — and as an apology, to boot!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, well, since you put it that way... we graciously accept!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What do you plan to do next?

dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: I've still got some cargo stocked up. Normal operations should put our finances back on track.

dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: Of course, we're not in an emergency situation this time, so I'll be doing honest business, don't you worry!

dialogues.speaker: Kulemana
dialogues.text: Ten, twenty... Sold a bunch of stuff, so our finances should be healthy for now...

choices.text: Not going to try and make a bit more?

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: Haha, nope! I'm calling it quits for now! If you hadn't been so understanding and helped me out, I'd have gotten myself into trouble over those couple of jade bits for sure.

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: Besides, constantly chasing money is boring. It's just a hobby for me. Observing the volcano is what really matters.

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: We can always make more money, but if an eruption warning doesn't get sent out on our account... that would be a huge loss.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Don't you get funding from the Speaker's Chamber?

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: We didn't apply for any. With all the stuff they already have to deal with on the daily, I doubt they need the extra stress.

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: The gang and I are a different story. We're used to funding our own travels by picking up odd jobs as we go. It's become a lifestyle, you know?

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: As such, monitoring the volcano while we travel isn't a big deal, just like how you often help people in need — it just comes naturally!

response.speaker: Kulemana
response.text: Take care, hehe. May we meet again!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll give it a try.
